scope: Cortex-M represented private state through actual VMM files, coordinated detached CPU publication, and exported C API contexts

assumption_register.assumption: Public Cortex-M registers omit state that changes continuation.
assumption_register.dependent_results: Private producer and context format required.
assumption_register.stress_test: Actual VMM files: count, WFI sleep, SEV/WFE.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Restored execution equals uninterrupted execution without private bytes.

assumption_register.assumption: Raw modeled controller fields are state; register replay can consume them.
assumption_register.dependent_results: Install admitted typed controller images directly.
assumption_register.stress_test: All eleven variants; reset request, pending interrupts, sticky COUNTFLAG, SysTick phase and local reservation consumed exactly once.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Byte divergence or missing/doubled side effect.

assumption_register.assumption: A detached CPU cannot execute before target RAM publication.
assumption_register.stress_test: Canceled permit, entry/capture rejection, zero budget, foreign-memory scope, later CPU corruption/missing row.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Candidate enters early or rejected restore mutates target CPU/RAM.

assumption_register.assumption: GDB controls belong to the current session.
assumption_register.dependent_results: Candidate inherits target CPU break/watch controls.
assumption_register.stress_test: Different source/target controls; actual GDB file-restore lifecycle in full root binary.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Source controls replace current target controls or rebind regression fails.

assumption_register.assumption: Legacy projection contexts retain their existing limited contract.
assumption_register.dependent_results: Absent section / C format 1 or 2 accepted without fabricating execution phase.
assumption_register.stress_test: Actual 1/2/4-CPU legacy files and C API old framing.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Legacy rejected or missing counters reconstructed.

assumption_register.assumption: CPU-owned pending exception queues need a storage bound beyond a byte limit.
assumption_register.dependent_results: At most 262144 decoded entries; fixed-size NVIC priority tuple.
assumption_register.stress_test: Oversized queue encoding rejected; raw counter maximum wraps safely with overflow checks enabled.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Unbounded allocation, panic, or changed continuation.

bounded_scope.item: All four original full findings remain open; physical Intel, native in-flight/IRQ/clock/replay and SMP qualification are independent.
This preserves represented Cortex-M software state; it does not implement the absent Floating-point Extension, MPU, external SCS MMIO wiring or additional interrupt execution semantics.
Cortex-M retains its existing local-only exclusive monitor; shared writer invalidation/coherence is not established by this group.
Legacy contexts without private bytes cannot recover omitted counters/sleep/events.
Independent raw RAM writers remain the caller's quiescence responsibility.

complexity: For C CPUs, B encoded bytes and Q pending entries per CPU, framing and private preparation are O(C+B+Q) time and O(B+Q) auxiliary space within fixed caps; direct controller installation is constant size plus queue ownership transfer. RAM copy is separately O(R).
evidence_boundary: Software model preservation and current Apple Silicon host behavior; no new architectural-hardware-fidelity claim.

reviewed_fields.NVIC: All declared controller fields serialized; priority[496] is a fixed tuple, not a vector.
reviewed_fields.SCB: All declared controller fields serialized; immutable variant/CPUID checked.
reviewed_fields.SysTick: All declared fields serialized; readonly clocks/calibration and bounded raw counters checked.

constraints: Snapshot retains raw set_sp values from the existing ArmCpu API; checkpoint admission does not silently align them.
NVIC cached mask/current-exception fields need not equal core fields because existing paths update them lazily.
Unused NVIC words are retained; do not invent zero constraints absent from existing model mutators.
SysTick tick drains the accumulator at modeled boundaries; profile clocks fixed by target constructor.
Current Cortex-M targets have no implemented FPE; vfp=Some is rejected.
No host debugger controls imported from source.
C API standalone import publishes only after new memory has been copied; VMM uses detached permit after shared RAM publication.
Map reconstruction invalidates local reservation rights without resetting represented CPU/controller phase.
